kept_reviewed: Rows whose description names robots they make are robot entries and stay: e.g. Hiopos (HIOBOT), Norma (ElRobot arm), Ati Motors (autonomous mobile robots), Dyna Robotics (mobile dexterous robots). Hand makers (Shadow, Proception, Linkerbot) are left for a separate review: a robotic hand may be a component product or a robot, and that is not clear from the record alone.
after_receipt: Claude re-downloads the master, regenerates the Other Robots and Software previews, adds the seven retired /other-robots/<slug>/ addresses to tools/permalinks.json as redirects to the destinations above (realtime, harmonic-drive, robonomics, bumerania, intrinsic, mujin, eka), checks counts and pages, and publishes by PR. No row is deleted on the web without its redirect.
